TREE: built top-down from Wayfair's OWN category navigation block, BlockBuilderCategoryStandardCategoryNavigation (rendered either as MenuListItem rows or CompactImageCard tiles), read out of each hub's server HTML. Entry points were located from the site's mega-menu in the page source plus the category sitemap https://www.wayfair.com/seo-category-sitemap~0.xml (893 /cat/ hubs). Wayfair has no single 'Bath' department; its Bathroom tree is spread over five hubs, and ALL FIVE were walked to exhaustion: (1) Home Improvement > Bathroom Remodel & Bathroom Fixtures /home-improvement/cat/bathroom-remodel-bathroom-fixtures-c215774.html (16 children), (2) Bed & Bath > Bathroom Accessories & Organization /bed-bath/cat/bathroom-accessories-organization-c424811.html (14 children), (3) Storage & Organization > Bathroom Storage & Organization /storage-organization/cat/bathroom-storage-organization-c215892.html (11 children - every one of them a duplicate URL of a node already recorded, so it contributed no new rows), (4) Furniture > Bathroom Furniture /furniture/cat/bathroom-furniture-c45985.html (4 children, of which only Small Space Bathrooms > Small Vanities and Single Hole Faucets were new), (5) Bed & Bath > Shower Curtains & Accessories /bed-bath/cat/shower-curtains-accessories-c424833.html (8 children). Bed & Bath > Bath Rugs & Towels and Lighting > Bathroom Lighting were also walked, purely so their nodes could be routed out explicitly rather than silently skipped. QTY: every leaf number is the listing page's own total, taken from the resultCount field inside the page's Next.js RSC payload - the exact value Wayfair renders in the 'N Items' header above the grid. VERIFICATION: for all 62 leaf pages the resultCount value was matched character-for-character against the literally rendered header string scraped from the same document (e.g. Urinals resultCount 86 / rendered '86 Items'; Bidet Components 19 / '19 Items'; Shower Panels 464 / '464 Items'; Grab Bars 846 / '846 Items'; Bathroom Wall Shelves 323 / '323 Items'; Toilets 10070 / '10,070 Items'; Shower & Bathtub Doors 45234 / '45,234 Items'). The ONLY divergence is that above 50,000 Wayfair renders the rounded string 'Over 50,000 Items' - this affects 4 recorded leaves (Single Vanities 157659, Freestanding Vanities 67024, Bathroom Cabinets & Shelving 54764) and 2 routed-out ones; for those the exact figure in the page's own payload was used, never an estimate. The remaining Contractor-tree nodes - Utility Sinks, Drinking Fountains, Changing Stations and Commercial Plumbing Parts & Accessories - are also listed in review with their exact counts so none is silently skipped. So the B2B tree adds no consumer Bathroom node that is missing above. A THIRD cross-check was run against Home Improvement > Plumbing (/home-improvement/cat/plumbing-c215750.html), the parent department of the Bathroom fixture nodes. Its nine children are Faucets, Sinks, Water Heaters, Water Filtration, Steam Showers/Units & Generators, Drains, Shower & Bathtub Drains, Parts & Components and Valves. This surfaced ONE genuinely Bathroom node that Wayfair does not link from its own Bathroom hubs: 'Steam Showers, Units, & Generators' (/home-improvement/sb0/steam-units-c215783.html, resultCount 786 == rendered '786 Items', no child tiles). It is recorded as a Bathroom leaf because rule 2 ranks PRIMARY PRODUCT TYPE above website hierarchy and rule 6 explicitly includes shower systems; its true nav path (Home Improvement > Plumbing) is stated here rather than invented into the Bathroom tree. The other plumbing children are general plumbing/appliance nodes or aggregates of already-recorded bathroom leaves and are listed in review with their exact counts.
